name: gemini-founder-skill
description: Eleven free Gemini skills that test a business before you launch it: a board trained on Hormozi, Thiel and Jobs, a marketing director, a CFO, and a consumer panel of 100 buyer agents. Free, MIT.
suggestedPrompts: Use founder-board to pressure-test my business idea with the three-member board
Use founder-consumer --quick to test my pitch on 20 simulated buyers
Use founder-cfo to calculate unit economics, break-even volume, and Year 1 cash needed
